semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides specialized optical materials and processing services relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shinagawa Kogaku optics specializes in the integrated manufacturing of semiconductor optics, offering comprehensive services from rough grinding to advanced bonding techniques. They process a wide range of optical materials, including quartz and silicon, and provide tailored solutions for both standard and irregular shapes.
capabilities: Integrated manufacturing processes for semiconductor optics
Vapor deposition for single and multi-coating
Processing of over 200 types of optical materials
